sentences.text:
2. The present application has been preferred for the following relief(s):
(i) for that Modified Award dt.
28.02.2017 (hereinafter 'Impugned Modified Award') by the Rehabilitation Acquisition, Land and Resettlement Authority, Patna (hereinafter 'LARR Authority') on an application for review dt.
20.08.2016 in LA Reference Case No. 04/2015/Reference Case No. 05/ 2016 (P) (hereinafter 'Reference Review Case') be set aside as being without jurisdiction and thus null and void, whereby and where under the Learned LARR Authority has modified the Award dt. 23.07.2016 so finally given after a judgment dt.05.07.2016 in LA Reference Case No. 04/15-Reference Case No. 05/2016 (p) in Patna High Court CWJC No.10745 of 2018(10) dt.05-01-2026 spite of the fact that there is no provision in the 'Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013' (hereinafter referred as New LA Act) as well as First Appeals having already been filed before Hon'ble High Court under Section 74 of New LA Act by State of Bihar as well as the petitioner herein and having been numbered at Registry of the Hon'ble Court.

1 (ii) For any other relief/reliefs, which the Hon'ble court may grant in the interest of the Petitioner that may be deemed appropriate and necessary in this case.
3.
